name: Bulgaria: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Bulgaria package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment arrangements and informed-consent procedure present on template v2.0, with the first recruitment action and a section for every consent pathway in the plan (BDA: mandatory when recruitment is not fully described in the protocol; planned by default, DECISIONS.md D2).
K2 copies of every recruitment advertisement or item (printed, audio, visual), each with version and date.
One L1 PIS and ICF set per population in population_sets whose trigger is true, each in Bulgarian and as the Bulgaria English version.
L2 other written information given before the decision.
For every site: M1 PI CV and M2 PI declaration of interests on the EudraLex templates.
Planned trial-site list (BG-N2) in Bulgarian with English site name, address and PI name.
For every site: N1 Bulgaria site-suitability declaration on the national BDA template.
O1 insurance documentation covering all sites, departments or clinics and PIs, and at least the CTIS participant number for Bulgaria.
P1 compensation template and P2 financing and financial-arrangements information (or draft contracts).
R1 GDPR compliance declaration.
S1 biological-samples compliance declaration.
Recommended: national cover letter in Bulgarian naming a Bulgaria contact person with telephone and email.
Every site, investigator and population in CTIS has its corresponding document.
Every participant-facing and recruitment document is in Bulgarian; every L1 document also has its Bulgaria English version with the same content version and date.
N1 and the site list are in Bulgarian; M1, M2, O1, P1, P2, R1 and S1 are in Bulgarian and/or English.

Signed at submission: M2 by the principal investigator and N1 by the head of the institution; insurance valid and, if signed with a qualified electronic signature, verifiable. No other document carries an invented signature block; participant documents are unsigned review copies.
Compensation amounts and conditions identical in P1, P2 and every participant document.
Insurance wording in participant documents matches O1.
Site names, PIs and participant numbers identical in CTIS, BG-N2, every N1 and O1.
Sample types, storage, transfers and future use identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents.
Data flows, recipients and transfers consistent between R1, the participant documents and the protocol.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.

Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Bulgarian national additions (Article 97 signature structure, English Bulgaria versions, national site-suitability template) and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Bulgaria is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document.

Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document (_BG_bg and _BG_en for the two participant-document versions).
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title; the documents themselves carry version and date (BDA).
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished; for substantial modifications in line with the BDA's national instructions.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Bulgaria receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised CTIS transparency rules applicable from 18 June 2024; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).

Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material, irreversibly and unsearchably; author metadata removed; signatures (M2, N1) never disclosed.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
